# THIS IS THE LANE PI CANNOT REACH. tool_approval_requested and
# tool_approval_resolved are typed, first-class OMP events carrying a toolName
# and an approvalMode; Pi ships no permission system at all, so its blocked lane
# is structurally unreachable and this one is the ordinary case.
# The ordering is worth reading: tool_execution_start fires BEFORE the approval
# is requested, in the same millisecond. The asset ignores it, because it acts on
# tool_execution_start only for the ask tool; the block comes from the approval
# event. An asset that treated every tool_execution_start as work would be
# publishing working one event before the pane actually blocked.
# turn_start and turn_end fire TWICE inside this one agent run -- once around the
# tool call, once around the reply -- so a turn in this codebase's vocabulary is
# a provider round trip, exactly as Pi's traces measured. Neither is subscribed.
